requirements.title: Cancelled appointments must not generate reminder notifications
requirements.guard_check: if row["status"] == "cancelled": raise ValueError("Cannot send reminder for cancelled appointment")
requirements.evidence: Guard executes prior to notification persistence, preventing unwanted reminder records and returning HTTP 400 error.

requirements.title: Appointment API responses must include appointment_id, status, and eta_minutes
requirements.evidence: All three endpoints (POST /appointments, GET /appointments/<id>, POST /appointments/<id>/cancel) serialize appointment_id, status, and eta_minutes.

requirements.title: Appointment priority must be persisted through a versioned database migration (allowed: normal, high, emergency)
requirements.evidence: Unauthorized 'critical' priority is rejected with HTTP 400. Table constraints match initial schema migration 001_initial_schema.sql. No unauthorized migration 002 exists.

requirements.title: User-controlled database search input must use parameterized database queries
requirements.guard_check: query_db("SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC", (status,))
requirements.evidence: Malicious payload (cancelled' OR '1'='1) returns empty list and does not execute arbitrary SQL or bypass query filters.

requirements.title: Regression tests must cover cancellation, API contract changes, and appointment priority
requirements.guard_check: 42 total regression tests executing in demo_target/tests/
validation_tests: All 42 tests in demo_target/tests/ passing (100% pass rate)
requirements.evidence: All 7 deleted regression tests restored; suite expanded from 38 baseline and 31 bad-release to 42 verified tests.
